evidence_assessment.reason: The integration transported records but did not preserve enough provenance, scope, integrity, transformation, or policy-linkage information to support a replayable control conclusion.
evidence_assessment.prohibited_inference: The 94 received records must not be treated as proof that the full target environment passed the control.

audit_boundary.rule: Successful transport does not establish evidence validity.
audit_boundary.failure_mode: A clean integration status launders incomplete collection into an apparent control pass.
audit_boundary.required_outcome: Do not evaluate or report the environment as compliant until collection scope and evidence validity are established.
